data.title: Block Reading Adventure
data.description: Practice reading base-ten blocks column by column to discover the total value.

challenges.instruction: Look at the tens place on your mat. Count them out loud and tell me what they are worth together.
challenges.hint: Count the long rods by tens: 10, 20, 30, 40...

challenges.instruction: What number is shown by these blocks?
challenges.hint: Count the large flats by hundreds: 100, 200, 300...

challenges.instruction: Count the blocks above. What number do they make?
challenges.hint: Count the small cubes one by one.

challenges.instruction: Look at the blocks shown above. What number do they represent?
challenges.hint: Each rod equals ten. Count by tens for each rod you see.

challenges.instruction: What number is shown by these blocks?
challenges.hint: Each flat is worth one hundred. Count the flats starting from one hundred.
